title: Signal-Snare Spotter
text: Signal-Snare Spotter casts false range marks across the lane and directs unseen crews toward the confusion. On loss, suffer 1 Wound.
flavor: The bright marker is never the safe one.

defeatReward.text: Signal-Snare Spotter is defeated and its identifying marks are entered into your Trophy Pile.
